georef.scale.help: Leave at 1 unless your surveyor gave you a project scale.

updates.title: Updates
updates.channel.label: Update channel
updates.channel.stableHelp: Recommended. Releases that have been tested.
updates.channel.betaHelp: Early access to new features. It may contain bugs.
updates.channel.betaNote: Use Beta only if you accept occasional problems. You can go back to Stable at any time.
updates.channel.fromBetaNote: You are running a beta. It stays installed until a newer Stable version is released.
updates.channel.locked: The channel cannot change while an update is being checked, downloaded or waiting for a restart.
updates.auto.label: Check for updates automatically
updates.auto.help: Fabrilo checks once each time it starts. It never downloads or installs anything without asking you. The check only fetches a public file: no project data and no account information is sent (the server sees your IP address, like any website).
updates.idle: Select Check now to look for a newer version.
updates.availableHint: Fabrilo downloads the update first, then asks before it restarts.
updates.notes.label: What's new in {version}
updates.progress.label: Download progress
updates.downloadingHint: You can close this window. The download continues.
updates.readyHint: Restart Fabrilo to finish the update. You can do it later.
updates.confirm.title: Restart Fabrilo now?
updates.confirm.body: Fabrilo closes and reopens as version {version}. Open dialogs and changes you have not applied yet, such as a build-up you are still editing, are lost.
updates.error.network: Could not reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
updates.error.signature: The downloaded update could not be verified, so it was not installed. Your current version is unchanged.
updates.error.signatureHint: Try again later. If this keeps happening, download Fabrilo again from the Fabrilo website.
updates.error.manifest: The update information could not be read right now.
updates.error.manifestHint: Try again later, or download the latest version from the Fabrilo website. Installations made with the MSI package only receive Stable updates: choose Stable if you use Beta.
updates.error.install: Fabrilo could not install the update. Your current version is unchanged.
updates.error.installHint: Try again, or download the latest version from the Fabrilo website.
updates.error.other: Something went wrong with the update. Check again to continue.
updates.announce.available: Fabrilo {version} is available. Open Updates to download it.
updates.announce.ready: Fabrilo {version} is ready to install. Open Updates to restart.
updates.announce.failed: The update could not be downloaded. Open Updates for details.
updates.restart.windowsNote: On Windows, an installer window shows its progress for a few seconds before Fabrilo opens again.
